ver.errText: Try again; if it still does not load, give RightOne support the reference below.
ver.cursorTitle: This page of the list can no longer be used.
ver.cursorText: Nothing changed; reload from the first page.
ver.noNetwork: Opening, recording or concluding an inspection needs the network; what you typed is kept on the device and is sent only when you act again once the network returns.
ver.noAppointmentWhy: You hold no appointment in force at this moment.
ver.finding.RECORD_NOT_PRESENTED: No certificate presented at the time
ver.finding.EXTERNAL_LICENCE_PRESENTED: Licence granted outside the single window presented
ver.ack.REFUSED_TO_ACKNOWLEDGE: The representative declined to acknowledge the record
ver.followUp.RE_VISIT: To be inspected again before the date chosen
ver.followUp.AWAIT_REGISTRATION: Awaiting registration before the date chosen
refusal.NO_EFFECTIVE_APPOINTMENT: You hold no appointment in force at this moment, so no inspection act can be made. Nothing was recorded. Ask your authority to send your appointment to RightOne operations to be recorded.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_SUSPENDED: Your appointment is suspended, so this cannot be done. Nothing was recorded. Contact RightOne operations for the reason and how it can be reinstated.
refusal.AUTHORITY_NOT_ACTIVE: The inspection authority you act for is not designated at this moment, or its designation has ended, so nothing can be done in its name. Nothing was recorded.
refusal.POLICY_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the rules in force just now, so this cannot be done. Nothing was recorded. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED: Your account has not been given the right to do this, so nothing changed. If you need this right, contact RightOne support.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_REQUIRED: You hold more than one appointment; choose the authority you act for - on the field client’s home screen, or in the "Authority" field when requesting a list - and send again. Nothing was recorded.
refusal.KEYS_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the verification keys just now, so the keys were not refreshed or the result was not uploaded. The device keeps the keys it holds and the waiting result; try again when the network allows.
refusal.PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE: The scanned code could not be read, so this result cannot be uploaded. If you are still at the premises, scan the code again; if not, you can discard this result.
refusal.ANSWER_NOT_FOUND: No verification answer with this reference can be used here. Either the reference is wrong, its retention has passed, or it belongs to an appointment other than the one you act under. Nothing was attached or shown.
refusal.PREMISES_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read what it needs from the register just now, so this cannot be done. Nothing was recorded; try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.PAYLOAD_REFERENCE_MISMATCH: The certificate reference sent does not match the QR code scanned, so nothing was recorded. Scan the code on the certificate again; if it still does not match, type the reference printed on the certificate. For a result checked offline: if you are still at the premises, scan the code again; otherwise you can discard the result.
refusal.ANSWER_NOT_FOR_PREMISES: This verification answer is about another premises, so it was not attached to this inspection. An online answer is still stored on its own; a result checked offline is uploaded again by the app and stored on its own, attached to no inspection. Scan the code on the certificate of the premises being inspected.
refusal.OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION: This premises or area is outside your authority’s recorded jurisdiction, so it cannot be inspected or listed. Nothing was recorded.
refusal.JURISDICTION_NOT_RECORDED_FOR_GE: Your authority’s jurisdiction is not yet recorded under the administrative geography in force, so this cannot be done. Nothing was recorded; RightOne operations has been told to record the jurisdiction again.
refusal.OBSERVED_OUTSIDE_AUTHORITY: At the time you give for the inspection, your appointment or your authority’s designation was not in force, so this inspection was not recorded. Check the time it took place.
refusal.ANSWER_OUTSIDE_INSPECTION_WINDOW: This verification was made too long before the inspection took place, so it was not attached as its evidence. Nothing was attached. Verify the premises’ record again.
refusal.DELAY_REASON_REQUIRED: The inspection is being recorded after the time allowed, so a reason for the delay is needed. Nothing was recorded.
refusal.OBSERVED_AT_IN_FUTURE: The time of the inspection cannot be later than now, so nothing was recorded. Correct the time.
refusal.INSPECTION_NOT_FOUND: This open inspection does not exist in your authority, so nothing was recorded. Open the list of inspections again and choose again.
refusal.INSPECTION_NOT_OPEN: This inspection has ended, so nothing can be added and nothing was recorded. Where its record was issued, the reference is shown below. A record is corrected only where the related case requires it.
refusal.NOTE_REQUIRED: This kind of finding needs a note. Nothing was recorded.
refusal.PURPOSE_NOT_ADMITTED: This purpose is not one of the purposes allowed, listed below. No inspection was opened.
refusal.REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is needed for this. Nothing was recorded.
refusal.ABANDONMENT_NOT_PERMITTED: This inspection has a finding or a verification recorded, so it cannot be abandoned as opened in error. Nothing changed. Conclude it with the outcome that fits.
refusal.PENALTY_ROUTE_NOT_IN_FORCE: During the pilot, inspection gives guidance and makes no penalty referral. No record was issued. You can choose "Refer for case follow-up" and issue the record.
refusal.OUTCOME_NOT_SUPPORTED: No attached verification shows the premises’ certificate or status record in force, so the outcome cannot be compliant. No record was issued. Verify and attach the answer first.
refusal.RECORD_NOT_CURRENT_AT_INSPECTION: The issuing authority’s record shows no certificate or status record in force for the premises when the inspection took place (the state is shown below), so the outcome cannot be compliant. No record or version was issued. Choose another outcome.
refusal.OUTCOME_CONTRADICTS_FINDING: This outcome contradicts the finding named below, so no record was issued. Choose the outcome that fits what was recorded.
refusal.GUIDANCE_MISSING: Write the guidance given to the premises. No record was issued.
refusal.REFERRAL_NOTE_MISSING: A note saying what is referred is needed. No record was issued.
refusal.REPRESENTATIVE_ROLE_MISSING: Choose the role of the premises’ representative present, or record that nobody was present. No record was issued.
refusal.FOLLOW_UP_DATE_INVALID: A follow-up needs a date, and the date cannot be before the conclusion. No record or version was issued. Choose a date and send again.
refusal.CASE_INTAKE_UNAVAILABLE: The case could not be opened just now, and nothing was recorded. Send it again; it will not be opened twice.
refusal.CERTIFICATE_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the certificate authority’s record just now, so this cannot be done and nothing was recorded. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.NOT_ISSUING_AUTHORITY: Another authority issued this record, so only that authority can record its handover or a correction. Nothing changed.
refusal.ALREADY_DELIVERED: This record has already reached the premises, so a second handover was not recorded. The route and time recorded are shown below.
refusal.HANDOVER_TIME_INVALID: Give a handover time after the record was issued and not later than now. Nothing was recorded; correct the time.
refusal.RECORD_NOT_FOUND: No inspection record with this reference can be shown. Nothing changed. Check the reference printed on the record.
refusal.LIST_SUPPLY_LIMIT_REACHED: You have requested the number of lists allowed today, so this request was not recorded. You can request another from the time shown below (Vietnam time).
refusal.REGISTER_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the premises register for these areas, or the register has no defined population yet. No partial list was supplied, and this attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.RECORD_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the certificate records when it was generated. No partial list was supplied, and this attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.SCOPE_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the obligation decisions or the tariff scope when it was generated. No partial list was supplied, and this attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.DECISION_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the decisions, the payment deadlines or the reported changes when it was generated. No partial list was supplied, and this attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.GENERATION_TIMED_OUT: The list could not be made because generating it took longer than 15 minutes. No partial list was supplied, and this attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.SUPPLY_NOT_READY: This list is not ready, or could not be generated, so there is nothing to show yet. If it could not be generated, request it again.
refusal.ENTRIES_DISPOSED: The entries of this list have passed their retention and were deleted; the summary remains. Request a new list if you need one.
refusal.SUPPLY_NOT_FOUND: This list cannot be found. Nothing changed. Choose again among the lists of the period.

ver01.recordOffline: Opening a record needs the network.
ver01.prefixes: Prefixes: R1-CER-, CRP-, VRA-, IRC- or a premises reference
ver01.typedOffline: A typed reference needs the network; a scanned code can still be checked offline.

ver01.limited: Checked without a network: the code is authentic; the current state is not known
ver01.noKeyResult: This code cannot be checked offline, because the device holds no verification key for it or its keys are more than 7 days old.
ver01.dlgText: It was not uploaded to RightOne and is deleted from the device.
ver02.superseded: This printout is out of date; the details above are those of the record in force.
ver02.statement: The code proves who issued the record, not where it was scanned
ver02.notUploaded: This result has not been uploaded to RightOne.
ver02.refreshOff: Refreshing the keys needs the network.
ver02.willAttach: Attached to the inspection when uploaded
ver02.offlineHeading: Checked without a network: the code is authentic; the current state is not known
ver02.offlineBody: This code is authentic and unaltered. The details below are its state when it was printed ({p}). The current state was not checked, so a revocation or suspension since then cannot be excluded. The device’s verification keys were refreshed at {k} (Vietnam time).
ver02.outside: This premises is outside your authority’s jurisdiction, so only the public details are shown. To have it inspected, refer it to the authority for that area.
ver02.unable: It could not be checked just now because a system did not answer. This is not a result of no record. Try again in 5 minutes.
ver02.invalid: The reference is not in a form that can be used, or this kind of reference cannot be looked up. Check it, or choose another kind.
ver02.offlineKeys: This code cannot be checked offline, because the device holds no verification key for it or its keys are more than 7 days old. This is not a result of no record. When the network returns, refresh the keys or type the certificate reference to check online.
ver02.noRecord: No certificate or status record has this reference. That does not mean the premises is in breach. Check the reference; if it is wrong, the premises contacts the one-stop gateway for music copyright for help.
ver02.noPremisesInJ: The premises register holds no premises in your authority’s jurisdiction with this reference. The register may be incomplete, so this does not mean the premises is unregistered. Scan the code or type the certificate’s reference.
ver02.noCurrent: {p}, {a} holds no certificate or status record in force now. That does not mean the premises is in breach. Last known state: never issued.
ver02.noCurrentSuspended: {p}, {a} holds no certificate or status record in force now. That does not mean the premises is in breach. Last known state: suspended.
ver02.notAuth: This code could not be authenticated, so nothing it carries is shown. Type the reference printed on the certificate to check online.
ver02.ambiguous: This reference names {n} premises, so none was chosen. Scan the code or type the certificate reference of the premises you are inspecting.

ver08.statement.NO_CURRENT_RECORD: This list names premises holding no current certificate or status record in RightOne. That does not mean a premises is in breach: it may hold a lawful licence granted outside the single window, or be waiting for its record.
ver08.statement.NOT_CURRENT_WITH_DECISIO: This list names premises whose certificate or status record is not yet in line with the obligation decision in force. Each entry reflects a change not yet decided or a record not yet updated, not an act of the premises.
